_comment: A defect no published conformance case reaches, found while authoring the kata: it is not injected. W10 starts from it: write the case that would catch it, in the specification repository's generators, and watch every assembler either pass or fail it.

defects.find: if not policy.get("freshness_tiebreak", False) or not newest:
defects.why: Freshness breaks a tie between leaders only when the route's fact policy permits it (R-11). Without the permission check, a group the route meant to surface or refuse is decided by the clock.
